## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] Code formatting and linting are clean (`ruff check .`).
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials committed.
- [ ] Output contract and JSON schema remain strictly unchanged (`{"repository": "...", "violations": [...]}`).
- [ ] All read-only constraints are respected (no execution of inspected repository code).
- [ ] New features or bug fixes have accompanying unit tests.
